title: Preserve thumb and finger golpe marks
scope: Retain authored GPIF Golpe variants on beats and emit them in GP8.
acceptance: Cover Finger, Thumb and absence as distinct cases.
Preserve golpe with simultaneous notes and other independent techniques.
The independent consumer retains exact variants and locations; unknown values are diagnosed.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Sole public authority for the authored beat-level golpe variant.
Covers all variants, GP6-8 import and exact export, simultaneous notes, an independent fade, occurrence isolation, validation, diagnostics, strict policy, and read-only behavior.
Pinned AlphaTab verifies all 24 values and locations in the GP7 fixture plus a Finger-to-Thumb direct edit.
Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].bars[0].voices[0].beats[0].golpe. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.

Checked Finger/Thumb/absence, simultaneous notes and independent techniques, exact source and consumer locations, post-parse edits, unknown values, occurrence ownership, and no unrelated probe changes. GP3-5 have no authored golpe source record.

resolution: Added GolpeType None, Thumb, and Finger plus BeatEffects.Golpe as the sole authored authority. GP6 through GP8 import the direct GPIF Golpe element, GP8 emits the exact non-default token, and unknown tokens receive the scoped GPIF.Beat.Golpe.InvalidValue diagnostic. Validation rejects undefined public enum values before export. M10-GOLPE covers absence and both variants, all 24 real GP7 occurrences, GP6-8 parsing, exact wire output and Go reimport, a two-note beat with an independent FadeOut, reused-definition occurrence isolation, direct edits, nonmutation, validation, diagnostics, and strict policy. Pinned AlphaTab preserves all values and paths and observes a Finger-to-Thumb edit at the same beat. The 364-fixture probe changed only testdata/gp7/golpe.gp and testdata/gp7/golpe-tab.gp from 24/0 different to 24/24 equal-nondefault. Recognizing the source element removed 9 and 8 generic unknown-element diagnostics respectively. Reports, failures, target-blocked fixtures, and unrelated capability comparisons were unchanged. GP3 through GP5, tap/slap/pop, percussion, rasgueado, dead-slap, rendering, and playback remain outside this contract.
